original_card.question: Can one known scalar simplification be converted into an actual paid-profile improvement?
methods: Derive the changed legal frame itinerary and exact child histogram.
Prove a scoped obstruction showing why that scalar gain cannot change the paid contract.
original_card.acceptance_gate: An unchanged histogram is not a kappa gain; record any separate runtime or proof benefit explicitly.

first_step.inspect: Observe that the positive control improves scalar counts while retaining the paid histogram.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Choose one simplification and derive the complete changed frame itinerary, or prove why it cannot change the histogram.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A legal change to the histogram, not addition count alone, is the bridge to an exponent gain.
allowed_variations: One existing scalar simplification and one proposed frame-path change.
scope_change_triggers: Submitting only another scalar count as completion of a paid-profile task.

actual_scope: Audit the PR #3653 composed T488 published child histogram against the predecessor owner certificate and the literal helper output widths of both retimed canonical words.
scope_change_reason: Discussion #1166 comment 19022532 question 1 asks for an invoice of an already published composition. This is not a new scalar simplification and does not claim a paid-profile improvement.
bottleneck_link: The composed histogram is the paid profile that would enter a moment. Confirming it is the owner invoice plus a mass-zero local delta says the retiming did not create a new child histogram beyond that repricing. No new kappa.
stop_rule: Stop after the published histogram, idle residual and both helper-width lists agree, or at the first mismatch. Do not regenerate the integral-network journal or rerun admission.
evidence: verify.py recomputes helper output widths from frame ranks and the composed histogram from the owner certificate plus the local-bill delta.

ai_assistance: Substantial Cursor Grok assistance for the audit, verifier and notes.
